enabled.description: Whether to enable data collection for system activity statistics (e.g., CPU, memory, disk I/O).

collection_interval.description: Time (in seconds) between each data collection by sysstat.

history_days.description: Number of days to retain historical activity logs (e.g., in /var/log/sysstat).

compress_logs.description: Whether to compress old log files to save disk space.

rotate_logs.description: Whether to rotate log files when they reach maximum size.

sar_options.description: Default command-line options used when the `sar` command is run via scheduled tasks.

activities.description: List of system activity types to monitor and collect. Each activity enables/disables corresponding data collection.
